title: CHIP-8 Emulator
description: A pure Python CHIP-8 interpreter with 4K RAM, 16 registers, 64x32 display, delay/sound timers, and a complete opcode table. Runs any CHIP-8 ROM, with a built-in demo ROM that draws the word CHIP8 then runs a bouncing ball animation. Keyboard input mapped to CHIP-8 hex keypad (1qaz/2wse/3edc/4rfa). ASCII display with ANSI terminal rendering.
